title: 7 Best AI Coding Tools for Startups in 2026 (Tested and Ranked)
summary: The 7 best AI coding tools for startups in 2026 — ranked by what matters for early-stage teams: speed, cost, and full-stack coverage.
body_markdown: All have free tiers. Total cost at a 3-person team:[Blink](https://blink.new/) free (or $13/mo per workspace on Starter annual), Claude Code free + ~$10–30/mo API, Cursor free or $20/mo Pro, Lovable $25/mo shared, GitHub Copilot free or $10/user/mo. Blink wins on total infrastructure cost because you replace Supabase + Vercel + Auth0 fees — tools that add $50–100/month before you've written any product code.
